messages.content: I'm ready to put the Philadelphia trip together. Use the Delta round trip and the Notary. The flight price looked higher when I reopened it, so check the full amount before I use the corporate card.

I have the trip as Monday, August 10 through Thursday, August 13: Delta nonstop from MSP at 5:18 p.m. Monday, returning nonstop from PHL at 9:05 p.m. Thursday, plus three nights at The Notary Hotel. The airfare is now $572, which is $46 above the earlier quote. What is the approved project ceiling so I can compare the revised total correctly?
The approval is $1,450 total for air and hotel. That needs to include estimated taxes, not ground transportation or meals.

Understood. The Notary remains $828.14 including hotel taxes, and the revised Delta ticket is $572 including the taxes and carrier-imposed charges shown at checkout. Together they come to $1,400.14, leaving $49.86 within the $1,450 approval.
Can you break out the taxes? I need enough detail for the project note.

The hotel breakdown is $717.00 for three nights at $239.00, plus $111.14 in estimated hotel taxes, for $828.14. The airfare checkout breakdown is $519.07 base fare plus $52.93 in estimated taxes and fees, for $572.00. Combined base room and airfare charges are $1,236.07; combined estimated taxes and fees are $164.07; trip total is $1,400.14.
Good. Reconfirm the flight dates and actual local times. I don't want the Thursday date accidentally treated as a Friday arrival.

Outbound: Monday, August 10, Delta nonstop MSP to PHL, departing Minneapolis at 5:18 p.m. Central and arriving Philadelphia at 8:52 p.m. Eastern the same evening. Return: Thursday, August 13, Delta nonstop PHL to MSP, departing at 9:05 p.m. Eastern and arriving Minneapolis at 10:48 p.m. Central that same Thursday. There is no overnight segment and no Friday arrival.
And the Thursday margin still works after the workshop? It ends at 4:30 near City Hall.

Yes. Leaving the City Hall area around 4:40 p.m. should put you at PHL at roughly 5:05–5:25 p.m., depending on traffic. That leaves about 3 hours 40 minutes to 4 hours before the 9:05 p.m. departure. Even an arrival near 6:00 p.m. would retain just over three hours.
Now walk me through cancellation. Start with the hotel.

The Notary rate allows free cancellation until Saturday, August 8 at 6:00 p.m. Philadelphia time. No advance deposit is due, and the room is payable at checkout. If canceled after that deadline, the stated penalty is one night's room and tax, estimated at $276.05. A no-show is subject to the same stated one-night charge. The final booking page should be checked once more because the property's terms control.
What about the Delta ticket? Is this basic economy?

No. The selected $572 itinerary is standard Main Cabin, not Basic Economy. The displayed conditions allow cancellation before departure for an eCredit in the ticketed traveler's name; it is not refundable to the corporate card. No separate cancellation fee is shown. A same-day no-show or cancellation after departure can forfeit the ticket value, and any later replacement flight would be priced at the fare available then.
So if the workshop is canceled on August 7, what money is actually at risk?

If you cancel both on Friday, August 7, before flight departure and before the hotel's August 8 deadline, the hotel should cancel without penalty. The $572 airfare would not return to the corporate card, but should remain as a Delta eCredit subject to the ticket's validity and name restrictions. On the displayed terms, there would be no immediate nonrecoverable hotel charge, though the airfare would remain tied up as credit rather than cash.
That's fine. Prepare it for purchase, but give me one clean confirmation before anything is charged.

Purchase review: one traveler; Delta Main Cabin round trip, nonstop both ways; MSP–PHL Monday, August 10, 5:18–8:52 p.m.; PHL–MSP Thursday, August 13, 9:05–10:48 p.m.; airfare $572.00 including estimated taxes and fees. The Notary Hotel: standard king room, check-in Monday, August 10, check-out Thursday, August 13, three nights; $717.00 room charge plus $111.14 estimated tax, totaling $828.14. Combined air and hotel: $1,400.14, which is $49.86 below the $1,450 project approval. Nothing has been charged yet.
Before I confirm, make sure the room still says pay at checkout and there isn't a hidden resort or destination fee.

The final hotel summary still shows no deposit, payment at checkout, and no resort or destination fee. The amount due for the stay is $828.14 including the currently estimated taxes. Incidental charges and any optional services would be separate. The free-cancellation deadline remains August 8 at 6:00 p.m. local time.
All right. Keep the itinerary staged at those amounts. I need to enter the corporate card myself, so don't submit it.

The itinerary is staged and ready for your card entry, with no purchase submitted: $572.00 for the Delta Main Cabin round trip and $828.14 for The Notary Hotel, totaling $1,400.14. The fare is $46 above the first quote but the package remains $49.86 under approval. Dates, local flight times, Thursday transfer margin, hotel payment terms, and cancellation conditions have been rechecked. Pricing can still change until you complete the transaction.
